mika (AE): ClipperPay wants a quick POC to move from CompetitorY to Redwood. Main asks: prompt parity, streaming chunk alignment, output metadata preservation (they rely on a `confidence` array), and completed infosec packet. can eng/se scope?
jules (SE): we should request a 30-prompt sample + 5 streaming sessions. priority is minimal client changes, so a transparent proxy is preferred.
mika (AE): They also asked for a cost delta estimate for running a shadow test (duplicate traffic) and for any normalization passes.
ana (typo): 
kai (Eng): quick notes: CompetitorY injects invisible control tokens and appends a trailing metadata object with fields we don't produce. options: (1) fabricate metadata placeholders in proxy, (2) compute approximations on our side, or (3) ask client to accept a thin adapter in their app.
